title: Check-In Channel Rates for Checked Bags
content:
**Airport services channel terms — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The list charge of a checked bag is multiplied by the **check-in channel rate**, which follows the segment's check-in channel. The rate acts on the unrounded charge; rounding to the cent happens only at the end.

## The segment's check-in channel

The segment's check-in channel is the airport when any bag charge of that segment was paid at the airport, online when a bag charge of that segment was paid online and none at the airport, and the call center otherwise.

## The rate

| Check-in channel of the segment | Check-in channel rate |
|---|---|
| Airport | 1.1 |
| Online | 0.9 |
| Call center | 1 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Bag charges already on the segment | Channel | Rate |
|---|---|---|
| One paid online, one paid at the airport | Airport | 1.1 |
| Two paid online | Online | 0.9 |
| One paid through the call center | Call center | 1 |
| None | Call center | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A list charge of 50 dollars at the airport rate becomes 55.00 dollars.
